# Qingdao Lavino Equipment & Parts Co., Ltd.

> China-based supplier of agricultural machinery, farm machinery spare and wear parts,
> and replacement filters (air, oil, fuel, hydraulic) for agricultural machinery,
> construction machinery, heavy-duty equipment and trucks. OEM and customized
> products are available. Located in Qingdao, Shandong, China.

## Products
- [Agricultural machinery](https://www.lavinoequipment.com/products.html): rotary tillers, seeders, harvesters, mowers, vegetable transplanters, self-propelled sprayers, balers, ploughs, fertilizer applicators and more.
- [Farm machinery spare and wear parts](https://www.lavinoequipment.com/products.html): rotary tiller blades and holders, disc harrow blades, plough parts, PTO drive shafts, universal joints, bearing and oil seal kits, hubs and flanges, tyres, seat slides.
- [Replacement filters](https://www.lavinoequipment.com/products.html): air, oil, fuel and hydraulic filters for Caterpillar, Komatsu, Volvo, Doosan, Case, New Holland, JCB, SANY, XCMG, LiuGong, John Deere, Kubota, Yanmar, Perkins, Cummins and Weichai equipment.
